title: The full small affine etale site with standard finite coverings
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let $S_{\Et}$ be its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. The full small affine etale category consists of the objects $U\to S$ of $S_{\Et}$ with $U$ affine, and all $S$-morphisms between these objects; its inclusion into $S_{\Et}$ forgets only the affineness property. Its standard coverings are the finite families $\{f_i:V_i\to U\}_{i=1}^n$ of etale arrows whose images cover $U$; the empty family is allowed when $U$ is empty. The associated Grothendieck topology is the topology generated by these coverings, in the sense of sites [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology].

source.place: Definitions 0219 (definition-standard-etale), 021B(4) (definition-big-small-etale); site axioms 021C and fibre products 021D

proof.text: For fullAffineEtale_hasPullbacks, map a limiting WalkingCospan cone through Etale.forget S followed by Over.forget S. All diagram schemes are affine, so Mathlib Scheme.isAffine_of_isLimit makes the cone point affine. Closure under these limits gives pullbacks in the affine full subcategory.

For fullAffineEtalePrecoverage_isPretopology, use the same closure-under-pullbacks argument to show that the forgetful functor to schemes preserves pullbacks. Pull back Scheme.precoverage Etale along it using Precoverage.comap. Mathlib supplies its isomorphism, composition and base-change axioms, hence its toPretopology. Intersect it with Pretopology.finite. Verify equality of the resulting precoverage with fullAffineEtalePrecoverage: a finite presieve is enumerated by Fin using Fintype.equivFin on its uncurry set, and Scheme.ofArrows_mem_precoverage_iff gives precisely joint surjectivity and étaleness; conversely every Fin-indexed family has a finite uncurry set. This includes the empty family.

For both sheafification theorems, lift AffineEtale.Spec S through the affine object property. ObjectProperty.lift preserves fullness and faithfulness. Every affine étale U is isomorphic to the image of the object Spec Gamma(U) with structure morphism U.isoSpec.inv composed with U.hom, using MorphismProperty.Over.isoMk and ObjectProperty.isoMk. Thus the lifted functor is an equivalence. Transport Mathlib EssentiallySmall for AffineEtale along it with essentiallySmall_congr, then apply hasSheafifyEssentiallySmallSite in universe uS for Type uS and AddCommGrpCat uS. No identification of Grothendieck topologies is needed: this theorem works for any topology on an essentially small category.
